name: Password Sign-In Requires TOTP
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a durable identity whose only available MFA method is TOTP; the server returns the generic MFA-required outcome and the client routes directly to the canonical TOTP continuation surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active password-enabled durable identity has TOTP available and no Passkey available for MFA

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Submit the password through the normal password-sign-in flow and receive the generic MFA-required server outcome; the one-element available MFA provider set selects TOTP directly.

postconditions.expression: the password proof has succeeded, no authenticated application session is active, and the client has routed the TOTP-only result to auth.continue.totp

sourceReferences.note: RequiresTwoFactor returns the generic MFA-required state without completing application sign-in.
The server transition is generic MFA Required and does not own the TOTP destination.
Expected client destination when TOTP is the only available MFA method.
A one-element availableMfaProviders list routes directly to that method; provider-specific routing does not require a distinct C# flow proof.
